assertion.statement: In v2.0.0, Crossplane core removed the code that returned an error when --enable-environment-configs was set. That error said native EnvironmentConfig loading and patching was no longer supported and the flag would be removed in a future release.

proposal.undeterminedReason: change: The diff shows only that the error-return line rejecting --enable-environment-configs was removed in v2.0.0. It does not say whether the flag itself was removed or what happens now when the flag is set.; consequence: The evidence does not say what happens in v2.0.0 to a Crossplane pod started with --enable-environment-configs. For example, it does not say whether the flag is rejected as unknown or silently ignored.
